correctness.rationale: For symmetric binary adjacency A, the SRG identity mod 2 gives A²=(k-μ)I+(λ-μ)A+μJ. B=[[A,I],[I,0]] is invertible and B+B^{-1}=diag(A,A). Exhaustive feasible parity classification yields A²=0 (B order 4); constants/H split for even k,λ and odd μ (order 10); or A(A+I)²=0 (order 6). Ker(B+I) and ker(B²+I) give d0 and 2d0; a one-primary/zero-primary decomposition gives d0+2d1 for B³+I. Independent GF(2) matrix calculations reproduced cycle C5 order10 with fixed dims 1,2,9,10 and rook K2,2 / 4x4 rook order4 and predicted nullities. Möbius inversion counts primitive cycles. Abiad–Haemers full text confirms symplectic ranks 2ν and 2ν+2.
residual_risks: Fixed-period formulas are for characteristic two, simple nontrivial strongly regular graphs; no odd-characteristic assertion.
